rows.grounds: specifies a measure of one unit
compound indicating a measure of two or three mātrā units
compound describing the foot lifted up from the pedestal

items.question: What alternative measures are permitted for raising the foot from the pedestal?
premises: A raised foot from the pedestal is the subject of the prescribed posture.
One measure is presented as a permissible option.
Two or three measures are presented as alternative permissible options.
items.inference: The foot may be raised from the pedestal by either one measure or by two or three measures.
uncertainties: The exact physical length corresponding to a mātrā in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Or the foot may be raised from the pedestal by one measure, or by two or three measures.
